senses.gloss:
Ābayu is apparently the name of a plant in the Atharvaveda;^1
the mustard plant^2 may have been meant, but the sense is
quite uncertain.^3
1) vi. 16, 1.
2) Bloomfield, Hymns of the Atharva-
veda, 465, following the indication of the
use of the hymn in the Kauśika Sūtra.
3) Whitney, Translation of the Athar-
vaveda, 292; Zimmer. Altindisches Leben,
72.
